name: ZCH_DATA_MGMT_BATCHES_B
description: This table stores batches information to identify duplicates in a system. It uses data quality rules to identify duplicate records to automatically or manually merge the duplicate records.

columns.name: DATA_MGMT_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Primary key

columns.name: BATCH_NUMBER
columns.description: Identification Batch Number

columns.name: BATCH_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the identification batch

columns.name: PROCESS_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Processing options: auto create duplicate request, auto create duplicate request and auto merge, manual review, auto cleansing, simulate cleansing

columns.name: OBJ_NAME
columns.description: The object name to run match or cleansing, party, address, location ect.

columns.name: OBJ_DEF
columns.description: The merge object definition, whole package name

columns.name: ASSIGNED_USER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the User assigned to the batch

columns.name: BATCH_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the Batch. Example, CLEANSING, MATCH or INTERNAL

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: TOTAL_RECORDS_PROCESSED
columns.description: Total nu,mber of records processed

columns.name: TOTAL_RECORDS_ERROR
columns.description: Number of records are not updated to base table because of error

columns.name: BATCH_START_TIME
columns.description: Batch start time

columns.name: BATCH_END_TIME
columns.description: Batch end time

columns.name: PROCESS_DURATION
columns.description: Process duration

columns.name: PROCESS_DURATION_UOM
columns.description: Unit of measure for process duration. It could be hours, or minutes

columns.name: PROCESS_MODE
columns.description: Cleanse mode or validation mode

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUESTED_USER_ID
columns.description: This column stores the actual user who created the record.

columns.name: REPEAT_FLAG
columns.description: To indicate if this batch is a template only

columns.name: PARENT_BATCH_ID
columns.description: The identifier of the original template batch where this batch is copied from

columns.name: CONFIG_CODE
columns.description: To store the DQ batch config code

columns.name: DQ_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Indicates the ESS request ID of the DQ job

columns.name: MATCH_MODE
columns.description: To store the mode of the DQ match

columns.name: MATCH_THRESHOLD
columns.description: The minimum match score required for match results to be returned. Can take values of 0-101.

columns.name: MATCH_CLUSTER_LEVEL
columns.description: The cluster level of keys based on which records are matched for identifying potential duplicates. Can take values of 1(Normal), 2(Typical) and 3(Exhaustive).

columns.name: MERGE_THRESHOLD
columns.description: The minimum match score required for duplicates to be merged with the master. Can take values of 0-101.

columns.name: LINK_THRESHOLD
columns.description: The minimum match score required for duplicates to be linked with the master. Can take values of 0-101.

columns.name: SEND_NOTIFICATION
columns.description: To indicate whether merge processing notifications will be sent for merge requests created from this batch.

columns.name: CLNS_MIN_VERIF_LEVEL
columns.description: Configuration to specify minimum verification level to which an address should match before cleansing

columns.name: CLNS_MIN_VERIF_SCORE
columns.description: Configuration to specify minimum verification score which an address should achieve before being cleansed

columns.name: CLNS_DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Configuration to specify default country value which will be used for cleansing, if an address does not have a country field value

columns.name: CLNS_OUTPUT_CASE
columns.description: Configuration to specify the case of a cleansed address. Example: upper case, lower case, and so on.

columns.name: CLNS_PARTIAL_VERIF_ALLOWED
columns.description: Configuration to specify whether a partially matched address  should be cleansed

columns.name: CLNS_AMBIGUOUS_ADDR_ALLOWED
columns.description: Configuration to specify whether an ambiguous match should be cleansed

columns.name: CLNS_RETURN_NATIVE_SCRIPT
columns.description: Configuration to specify whether a cleansed address output should be saved in a native script

columns.name: OBJ_FILTER_EXPR
columns.description: Object filter expression used in the batch selection criteria.
